name: Akaba Chizuru
source:
Chizuru is the student council secretary and a mature woman who seems to spend most of her time being quite serious. Chizuru is very manipulative at times and also has a sadistic side to her. While she is identified as the cool, serious type, she can embrace her more cutesy side occasionally, for example, hopping around dressed as a cute sheep while saying "mokyu".

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Student_Council%27s_Discretion]Wikipedia[/url]]
